include(${NAP_ROOT}/cmake/nap_utilities.cmake)

project(ffmpeg)

set(platform_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${NAP_THIRDPARTY_PLATFORM_DIR}/${ARCH})
set(include_dir ${platform_dir}/include)
set(lib_dir ${platform_dir}/lib)

macro(addLib name)
    if (APPLE)
        add_import_library(${name} ${lib_dir}/${implib_prefix}${name}${implib_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${dll_prefix}${name}${dll_suffix} ${include_dir})
        add_static_import_library(${name}${static_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${static_lib_prefix}${name}${static_lib_suffix} ${include_dir})
    elseif (WIN32)
        add_import_library(${name} ${lib_dir}/${implib_prefix}${name}${implib_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${dll_prefix}${name}${dll_suffix} ${include_dir})
        add_import_library(${name}${static_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${implib_prefix}${name}${implib_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${dll_prefix}${name}${dll_suffix} ${include_dir})
    else ()
        add_import_library(${name} ${lib_dir}/${implib_prefix}${name}${implib_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${dll_prefix}${name}${dll_suffix} ${include_dir})
        add_import_library(${name}${static_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${implib_prefix}${name}${implib_suffix} ${lib_dir}/${dll_prefix}${name}${dll_suffix} ${include_dir})
    endif ()
endmacro()

addLib(avcodec)
addLib(avdevice)
addLib(avfilter)
addLib(avformat)
addLib(avresample)
addLib(avutil)
addLib(swresample)
addLib(swscale)
